title: 第1章 人脉系统，你给我来了个土地公公？
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“张瑀，要不你还是找个班上吧。”

说话的人叫李文高，是房东。

此刻他正站在万事通中介门口，手里捏着一串钥匙，看着门头上那块褪色的招牌直摇头。

张瑀从柜台后面抬起头来，脸上挂着标准的营业微笑。

“李哥，我这店开着呢，上个月不是刚交了房租吗。”

“就是因为你交了房租我才来劝你。”李文高叹了口气，“你这中介开了一年多了吧？你自己算算，除了上个月帮人排了个专家号，你还接过什么像样的单子？代排队、代抢票、代挂号，这些业务撑死赚个跑腿费，你图啥呢？”

张瑀张了张嘴，想说点什么。

但李文高说得没错。

他穿越到这个平行世界已经一年零三个月了，开局就继承了这间开在城中村巷子里的破中介。

营业执照上的经营范围倒是挺全乎——中介服务、信息咨询、票务代理，但说白了就是个跑腿的黄牛。

这行当，放在如今，网上抢票软件遍地都是，线下排队的活儿又被大爷大妈们包圆了，他能活着全靠运气。

“行吧，我再想想办法。”张瑀敷衍了一句。

李文高见他油盐不进，摇着头走了，临走前丢下一句话：“下个季度的房租别忘了啊，三个月一起交，四千五。”

四千五。

两千一百二十三块六毛。

距离交房租还有两个月。

他靠在椅背上，盯着天花板上那盏摇摇欲坠的日光灯管，心想这回怕是真的要凉了。

穿越者混成这样，说出去都丢人。

别人穿越过来不是带着系统就是带着金手指，他倒好，穿过来一年多了，别说系统了，连个属性面板都没见着，整个人的穿越体验就跟原住民一模一样。

工作日复一日，平淡如水，毫无波澜。

他甚至怀疑自己是不是穿了个假越。

就在这时候，他眼前突然一花。

【检测到宿主执念值累积达标……】

【正在加载人脉系统……】

【加载完成。】

【人脉系统已绑定宿主：张瑀。】

【本系统将为宿主提供跨位面人脉匹配服务，可根据宿主需求匹配不同位面的专业人士、神灵、异兽等，协助宿主完成客户委托。】

【系统规则如下：】

【一、宿主需收取客户基础费用，并可额外加价，加价部分即为宿主利润。】

【二、加价幅度越高，可匹配的人脉等级越高，解决问题的效果越好。】

【三、所有委托必须在宿主能力范围内——宿主始终是客户的唯一对接人，任何人脉方均需通过宿主进行转达。】

【四、系统及人脉方不可被除宿主之外的任何人察觉，违者将遭受惩罚。】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Zhang Yu, why don't you find a classmate?"

The speaker is Li Wengao, the landlord.

At this moment, he was standing at the door of Wanshitong Agency, holding a bunch of keys in his hand, looking at the faded sign on the door and shaking his head.

Zhang Yu looked up from behind the counter, with a standard business smile on his face.

"Brother Li, my store is open. Didn't I just pay the rent last month?"

"I'm here to persuade you just because you paid the rent." Li Wengao sighed, "Have you been operating as an agency for more than a year? Do the math for yourself. Apart from arranging an expert number for someone last month, what other decent orders have you received? Standing in line, grabbing tickets, and registering. These businesses are all about earning a running fee. What are you doing?"

Zhang Yu opened his mouth, wanting to say something.

But Li Wengao was right.

It has been a year and three months since he traveled to this parallel world, and he inherited this shabby agency in the alley of the urban village at the beginning.

The business scope on the business license is quite comprehensive - intermediary services, information consulting, and ticketing agents, but to put it bluntly, he is just an errand scalper.

In this business, nowadays, online ticket grabbing software is everywhere, and the offline queuing work is taken care of by uncles and aunts. His survival depends entirely on luck.

"Okay, I'll think of a way." Zhang Yu said perfunctorily.

Li Wengao saw that he was not getting enough, so he shook his head and left. Before leaving, he left a sentence: "Don't forget the rent for next quarter. Pay it together for three months, four thousand and five thousand."

Four thousand and five.

Two thousand one hundred and twenty-three dollars and six cents.

There are still two months until rent is paid.

He leaned back in his chair and stared at the shaky fluorescent tube on the ceiling, thinking that it might really get cold this time.

The time-travelers are so messed up that it would be embarrassing to tell anyone about it.

Others traveled through time with either systems or gold fingers, but he was lucky enough to have traveled through time for more than a year. Not to mention the system, he didn’t even see an attribute panel. His entire time-travel experience was exactly the same as that of the aborigines.

Work day after day, as plain as water, without any waves.

He even wondered if he was wearing fake clothes.

At this moment, his eyes suddenly lit up.

[It is detected that the accumulation of host obsession value reaches the standard...]

[Loading the personal network system...]

[Loading completed.】

[The human connection system has been bound to the host: Zhang Yu.】

[This system will provide the host with cross-dimensional human connection matching services. It can match professionals, gods, exotic beasts, etc. in different planes according to the host's needs, and assist the host in completing customer commissions.】

[The system rules are as follows:]

[1. The host needs to charge the customer a basic fee, and can add additional fees. The increased price is the host's profit.】

[2. The higher the price increase, the higher the level of matching connections, and the better the problem-solving effect.】

[3. All entrustments must be within the scope of the host's capabilities - the host is always the client's only contact person, and any connections must be conveyed through the host.】

[4. The system and connections cannot be detected by anyone except the host. Violators will be punished.】
